name: Tracklog
summary: Scrobbles what you play on your Mac to three services.
description:
Tracklog is a scrobbler that lives in Droppy. It reads the system's now-playing feed, applies your edits and blocks, and sends what you listen to Last.fm, ListenBrainz and Libre.fm. A local queue keeps scrobbles safe while you are offline, and a local history keeps your listening in one place.

Tracklog is a clean-room implementation inspired by Pano Scrobbler, and is not affiliated with it.
